rootCauseAnalysis.primary: Investor close delay is compounding all three KPI failures. The cascade is: investor anxiety → procrastination → deck not sent → valuation leverage lost → cash runway pressure → team uncertainty → execution slowdown.
rootCauseAnalysis.secondary: FOCO outlet #14 cash burn continues unchecked. Acquisition LOI blocker creating team stall.
rootCauseAnalysis.tertiary: Operations work consuming time that should be reserved for investor conversations.
rootCauseAnalysis.systemFix: After you exit Emergency Mode, implement 'Investor Tuesday/Thursday' — 2-hour blocks on these days that nothing can preempt. This prevents the procrastination → cascade → emergency cycle.

knowledgeDocs.title: FK ₹1,100 Crore Plan Blueprint Summary
knowledgeDocs.summary: Overview of the primary milestones, targets, and model breakdown.
knowledgeDocs.content: FK Plan targets ₹1,100 Crore annual group ecosystem revenue by September 2030. Sourced from: 400 FOCO outlets (₹480 Cr), 8 acquired businesses (₹400 Cr), and apps ecosystem of 100,000 paid users (₹200 Cr). FK direct revenue retention target is 159 Cr/year.

knowledgeDocs.title: The Ownership Rule
knowledgeDocs.summary: Strategic constraints governing all standard commercial relationship gates.
knowledgeDocs.content: RULE: Every new relationship = FK gets at least ONE of: 20%+ equity, perpetual revenue share, master franchise rights (5+ years), or full IP ownership. Consulting without ownership is strictly prohibited.

knowledgeDocs.title: FOCO Expansion SPV Mechanics
knowledgeDocs.summary: Structuring and investor metrics for building 400 outlets.
knowledgeDocs.content: SOP: Each outlet is pooled inside a distinct asset shell Special Purpose Vehicle (SPV) with 4 key investors placing ₹7.5L each (Total ₹30L). Brand operates, FK collects 6% fee directly, retains 25% for platform operating cash, and distributes 75% back to SPV investors monthly. Expected ROI is 18-22%.
